posts.cooked:
On the kickstarter page it says :

 

"To reward you for sharing the campaign, we’ve got Social Goals lined up. We’ll post regular updates about progress toward the goals, which will unlock fun rewards for you! [...] YouTube: 0 / 25 Make a video using SotM music and send us the link to be counted! We’ll post videos in a playlist on our YouTube account, and highlight some here in updates."

 

Now I don't have video making talents. But I have an idea, and need some help executing it. I was thinking of doing a quick and dirty animation using my sprites to reflect upcoming battles in the season 2 game with some music. Have a Dark Watch team, the Freedom Five, etc...

I have the music from the soundtracks (except the wrath of the cosmos). 

Whatever we do I know I will need to make more action based sprites.

Anyone willing to join me on this endeavour?
